notes: De Makron, Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat 278 (BAG), built 2015: a U-shaped residential block. SE front (w01-155, 2023-03-06): shops on a plinth, four brick storeys with French balconies, a set-back yellow-brick top storey, a slate-clad central tower over a metal entrance canopy lettered de MAKRON. SW canal front (w04-240, 2017-03-10): same grammar over the Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat canal. NW and NE walls have no usable photograph (candidates 0 for w03-335, w05-65).

Modelled: a one-storey ground row of recessed shop windows on the SE front (deepBars) and punched-window groups on the set-back upper walls (SE and SW). The 3DBAG LoD2.2 front wall has its eaves at 5 m (roof inside is low), so the group is one storey and the upper brick floors are blank wall (blankStoreys), which hides the real four balconied floors.
